headline: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra Solves Complex Math Theorem, Pioneers New Proof Strategy
summary: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra has achieved a significant milestone by independently proving Smoktunowicz's gap theorem, a feat no other AI has managed. This breakthrough highlights the potential of advanced AI in solving complex mathematical problems and may redefine the approach to mathematical formalization.
whyItMatters: This achievement underscores the growing capabilities of AI in complex problem-solving and could lead to new strategies in mathematical research and formalization.
